mintAuthority.summary: JUSD uses 14-day public minter applications and a 2% holding-period-weighted JUICE veto on Citrea, but does not qualify for D30. At the pinned block, Equity can asymmetrically wipe other holders because protocol equity is below 1000 JUSD; five accepted minters have unverified deployed code, and zero-window genesis minters plus the supply-conditional initialize path prevent proving universal unavoidable veto protection. Economically unbounded accepted-minter issuance and unknown whole-supply reconciliation retain the ordinary unbounded-reconciliation-unknown rung. The four canonical StablecoinBridge routes remain separately assessed under Bridge Risk. At the v10.05 campaign pin, the largest account-level aged-vote controller has 6513–6514 bps (floor / conservative ceiling); its own-account EOA key holds the recorded shares; no positive issuer/team affiliation was established. Concentration is diagnostic, not an affirmative admission threshold; no new H classification is claimed.

controls.capDescription: Holding-period-weighted JUICE votes admit a 200-bps unilateral minter veto. Equity cannot mint JUSD and is not a registered minter. kamikaze destroys the caller's votes as its budget, but restructureCapTable can asymmetrically burn other holders whenever JUSD equity is below 1000 JUSD; that condition holds at the pin.

JUSD() returns the JUSD deployment; JUSD.reserve() returns this Equity and JUSD.isMinter(Equity)=false. votes(holder)=balanceOf(holder)*((block.timestamp<<20)-voteAnchor[holder]); transfer/mint recipient anchors preserve only prior votes, and checkQualified requires votesDelegated*10000 >= 200*totalVotes. The active denyMinter selector 0x9b404da6 calls checkQualified on Equity. JUSD.equity()=75031618876204840259 (<1000e18), so restructureCapTable([], [0xe5c628a70762ee464673bb1044cb953c621206de]) from 0xc0817456051c7721086f03707e2cca5fe36aa5b0 succeeded in read-only eth_call at the pin, wiping a different holder without burning the caller. Under D30-R, override is insolvency-gated-restructure but fails closed as restructure-reachable. Investment transfers existing JUSD in; redemption burns JUICE shares and transfers existing JUSD out, with same-block protection and a last-share guard. Only restructureCapTable can eliminate the entire JUICE supply and reopen zero-supply initialize.

Newly transferred or minted shares add zero immediate votes; recipient-anchor rounding only destroys votes, and outgoing shares destroy their associated duration votes. Sorted unique helpers must delegate to the voter. This proves the voting model, not the admissibility of every override. Campaign citrea 13502000 (0x41d9a687e2603bf5cbce64ad19f23906565030b46ebdd70d5053682fab4a4f69): pinned totalVotes() 0x0d15fd77 = 8806148199596491799498721487940914929001; every candidate votes(address) 0xd8bff5a5, balanceOf(address) 0x70a08231 and delegates(address) 0x587cde1e joins the exact full voting census in executionCertificates. restructure.evidence: Citrea block 13496501 (0x1430d7dba56a5d5d8fb55680ef4a33465466fcfe0a39b92750664409be31f608), eth_call equity() returned 75031618876204840259 raw JUSD, normalized to 75.03161887620484 token units, below the source's 1000-JUSD threshold. Runtime-matched Equity restructureCapTable can burn arbitrary holders after checkQualified without symmetric sacrifice; a pinned cross-holder wipe eth_call succeeded. All normal redeem variants call calculateProceeds, rejecting shares + 1e18 >= totalSupply; ERC20 transfers to zero are rejected, and the only other share-burn call is restructureCapTable. Thus only restructure can reduce JUICE supply to zero. JUSD.initialize requires both supplies zero and currently reverts; its disabled-reactivatable path is dependent on restructure. Because restructure is currently reachable, D30-R does not exclude that path and adds restructure-reachable.

veto.evidence: Citrea block 13496501 (0x1430d7dba56a5d5d8fb55680ef4a33465466fcfe0a39b92750664409be31f608), pinned eth_call/eth_getCode and runtime-matched CitreaScan verified source. denyMinter(address,address[],string), selector 0x9b404da6, calls immutable reserve.checkQualified before deleting a candidate during its application period. Runtime-matched Equity declares private constant QUORUM=200 and tests votesDelegated*10000 < QUORUM*totalVotes. kamikaze budgets destruction from the caller's own votes, but restructureCapTable is an additional insolvency-gated asymmetric override. Current equity is below 1000 JUSD and a pinned cross-holder wipe succeeded. Under D30-R its classification is insolvency-gated-restructure, with an explicit restructure-reachable failure; it cannot qualify for D30 while this condition holds.

review.evidence: Citrea block 13496501 (0x1430d7dba56a5d5d8fb55680ef4a33465466fcfe0a39b92750664409be31f608), pinned eth_call/eth_getCode and runtime-matched CitreaScan verified source. D30 verdict: V1 fails (registry downstream closure partial); V2 fails (accepted unbounded paths have no new admission delay; eight genesis admissions had no veto window; initialize remains reachable after an insolvency-gated share wipe and zero token supply); V3 fails (200-bps holding-period voting is proven, but insolvency-gated-restructure is currently reachable below 1000 JUSD equity); V4 fails (all accepted minter execution cannot be rooted in continuing Equity veto); V5 passes (active parameter-change veto selector targets the authored JUSD controller); V6 fails closed (authorization census reconstructed, but capacity/code closure missing for five active minters); V7 fails for loss-interest issuance (fixed position rates cannot be minority-counter-proposed and elapsed interest is not capped at expiration). No D30 or D29 fallback credit is authored. Registry and Equity bytecodes match verified deployed source exactly. Savings has a 7-day qualified-holder overwriteable rate proposal with uint24 maximum 16777215 PPM (1677.7215% annually) and current/next zero rates; its earned interest is capped at available equity, so that payout is not native shortfall issuance. Position interest is usable principal times fixedAnnualRatePPM times elapsed time over 365 days; fixedAnnualRatePPM is uint24 with maximum successfully installed total 16777215 PPM (checked addition above that reverts), is only resynchronized on borrower mint, and _calculateInterest does not clamp time to expiration. Hub/position coverLoss can mint reserve shortfalls before principal burns and interest collection, so this path stays unbounded under D30-S rather than being relabeled raiseable/bounded. Reconciliation remains unknown: no newly obtained recurring whole-supply reconciliation establishes continuous/periodic coverage. Prior 2026-08-15 shutdown-notice research is historical evidence, not a refreshed active-incident or recovery verdict; the formerly official domain now resolves to a sale listing. Bridge-route data is untouched. v10.05 campaign typed-authority and voting evidence: citrea 13502000 (0x41d9a687e2603bf5cbce64ad19f23906565030b46ebdd70d5053682fab4a4f69), Equity citrea:0x2a36f2b204b46fd82653cd06d00c7ff757c99ae4 totalVotes() 0x0d15fd77 / votes(address) 0xd8bff5a5 / delegates(address) 0x587cde1e, source https://api.citreascan.com/api/v2/smart-contracts/0x2a36f2b204b46fd82653cd06d00c7ff757c99ae4.
